purpose: Feasibility envelope for early exits when historical option books are absent

pricing.forward_calibration: inverse put-call parity from paired observed mids
pricing.volatility_anchor: DVOL, adjusted by remaining tenor and explicit stress

execution.spread_basis: fraction of theoretical option premium, never fraction of BTC spot

gates: report a result envelope across spread and volatility scenarios
reject rules that work only in the central scenario
never mix synthetic quotes with observed quotes without a source field
do not use this experiment to authorize real-money trading
